capabilities: Render Vimeo sharing URLs written as Markdown image embeds into players
Display players in Reading View and Live Preview while keeping source Markdown intact
Support unlisted videos by keeping the privacy hash in the URL
Fetch video titles and upload years from Vimeo's oEmbed API for the link below the player
Leave plain links, ordinary images, YouTube embeds, and code blocks unchanged
extras: Not yet listed in Obsidian's community plugin directory, so it must be installed manually from release files; playback requires an internet connection, and enabling title retrieval sends video URLs (including privacy hashes for unlisted videos) to Vimeo's oEmbed API.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Vimeo sharing URL into an embedded player inside a note.

relations.evidence: Displaying an embed loads a player from Vimeo.

summary: Markdown-based Vimeo embedder that turns image-embed links into Vimeo players in Reading View and Live Preview while keeping the note unchanged.
